content: Postoperative management should prioritize the prevention of vitamin and mineral deficiencies. This can be achieved through appropriate dietary modifications and the use of supplements as needed. Patients may encounter a range of long-term complications, with common symptoms including nausea and fatigue. It is essential to maintain lifelong follow-up care to monitor and ensure optimal nutritional health while preventing metabolic imbalances. Comprehensive care is best delivered at specialized centers, where a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals can address potential risks effectively.
